svg.title: Dispatching rules Gantt
svg.text: 02 – Dispatching rules on one machine (FINAL-01, bottleneck): Gantt charts FIFO / SPT / EDD / CR / SETUP-grouping
6 work orders at time 0, machine last ran VC20. Cycle VC10 / VC20 / VC30 = 180 / 210 / 250 s, setup 150 s (2.5 min) at every model change (config values).
late part of a job (completion after due)
▼ due date of each job (label = job)
lateness L = completion − due; tardiness T = max(0, L)
slack = due − now − processing time (here same order as CR)
Reading: SPT gives the smallest mean flow time, EDD the smallest maximum lateness, SETUP-grouping the shortest makespan (2 setups) but J6 is 75.7 min late.
No rule wins every goal – choose by the goal, then test in the twin (FMS tab rules FIFO / EDD / SPT / SETUP).
FINAL-01, 6 jobs, setup 2.5 min per model change
